name: earmark
description: Purpose-bound money on Hedera: an HTS stablecoin escrowed into KYC-gated vouchers that only approved merchants can receive, settled automatically at expiry by the Hedera Schedule Service, with signed charters and itemised receipts anchored on HCS.

sections.title: Try it against the shared testnet deployment

steps.text: Open http://localhost:3000, connect MetaMask on Hedera Testnet (chain 296) and fund a program. dUSD comes from the built-in faucet.

sections.title: Run the whole lifecycle from the CLI

steps.label: Add a funded ECDSA testnet account to packages/nextjs/.env.local
Watch the network settle a program by itself (~6 minutes)

steps.text: README.md walks through every step; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.
